detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Ibutamorin (Encapsulated Solid)

Chemical Information:
  • Chemical Name: Ibutamorin
  • Molecular Formula: C₂₇H₃₆N₄O₅S
  • Molecular Weight: ~528.7 g/mol
  • Compound Class: Synthetic small-molecule research compound (non-peptide)
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Ibutamorin is a synthetic small-molecule compound produced via chemical synthesis and supplied as a solid research material. This product is provided in an encapsulated solid format to support controlled storage, handling, and analytical preparation within laboratory research environments.

The encapsulated format serves solely as a physical containment and presentation method and does not imply any route of administration or intended method of use. Ibutamorin is intended exclusively for controlled in-vitro laboratory research conducted by qualified professionals engaged in analytical or mechanistic studies involving small-molecule compounds.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro evaluation of small-molecule behavior in biochemical or molecular assay systems
  • Analytical method development involving synthetic non-peptide compounds
  • Laboratory studies examining structure–property relationships of heterocyclic small molecules
  • Comparative research involving chemically synthesized small-molecule analogues
Storage and Handling:
  • Store in a cool, dry environment away from direct light
  • Maintain container tightly sealed when not in use
  • Handle using appropriate laboratory safety and aseptic techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications.
  • Format: Encapsulated solid research compound
  • Appearance: White to off-white solid
  • Solubility: Soluble in appropriate laboratory solvents following removal from the encapsulation format for analytical use
Compliance Notice:

Ibutamorin is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
